newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume jumps as prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume jumps as prices ease.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange surged to 1,965 kg on Tuesday, from Monday's 515 kg, following lower world prices which encouraged arbitrage deals as well as physical demand, dealers said.
Gold eased to $360.15 an ounce and 1,436,500 lira per gramme, compared to $363.20 and 1,434,700 lira, in line with downward trends in European markets.
"The banks engaged in arbitrage deals which accounted for most of the trade, but there was also some physical demand fuelled by the lower prices," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira eased to 123,710 lira to the dollar, against 122,900 on Monday.
Of the day's total trade, 868 kg changed hands in the morning session, with 66.4 percent of the total turnover conducted in dollar terms.
